intro: Bahrain is an archipelago of over 30 natural islands and many reclaimed ones, linked to Saudi Arabia by a 25 km causeway.

chapters.title: Islands
text: Bahrain Island is the largest and mostly flat desert. The highest point, Jebel Dukhan, is only 134 m. Large areas of land have been reclaimed from the sea for new towns.

chapters.title: Climate
text: Summers are very hot and humid; winters are mild. A lone acacia called the Tree of Life survives in the desert.

keyTerms.meaning: Land made by filling in the sea.

places.title: Landscape tour
places.intro: Places that show the variety of Bahrain's landscapes. The numbers match the pins on the map.

items.name: Qal'at al-Bahrain
items.text: A Dilmun capital and later a Portuguese fort.
